sql: SELECT P.OBJECTID1,P.OBJECTID2,P.OBJECTID3,P.OBJECTID4,P.NODETYPE,P.SOURCESTATUS,P.TARGETSTATUS,P.UPGRADEACTION,P.TAKEACTION,P.COPYDONE,COUNT(*) AS N FROM PSPROJECTITEM P WHERE P.OBJECTTYPE=10 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PSQRYDEFN Q WHERE Q.QRYNAME=P.OBJECTVALUE1 AND Q.OPRID=P.OBJECTVALUE2) GROUP BY P.OBJECTID1,P.OBJECTID2,P.OBJECTID3,P.OBJECTID4,P.NODETYPE,P.SOURCESTATUS,P.TARGETSTATUS,P.UPGRADEACTION,P.TAKEACTION,P.COPYDONE ORDER BY N DESC
